definitions.explanation: Wages paid on a weekly basis. Less common in Japan than monthly salaries, but used in some part-time and short-term arrangements, especially in retail and food service.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧だ。
{週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I receive my weekly pay in cash.

examples.japanese: {週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活費|せいかつひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧やすい⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Weekly pay has the advantage of making it easier to plan living expenses.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧ (week) + {給|きゅう} (pay). Often appears in compounds like {週給制|しゅうきゅうせい} (weekly wage system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧: weekly payment
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: weekly wage system
- {週給|しゅうきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a weekly wage

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{月給|げっきゅう}→月給：04692_gekkyuu⟧: monthly salary — by far the most common arrangement in Japan
- ⟦{日給|にっきゅう}→日給：07960_nikkyuu⟧: daily wage
- ⟦{時給|じきゅう}→時給：04693_jikyuu⟧: hourly wage
